observations: Tall red gas cylinder with a protective shroud around the valve.
Significant paint peeling and surface abrasion across the body.
Standard screw-type valve visible at the top.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BURAIMO MARIAM' across the center.

claims.evidence: The extensive paint loss in photo 0 suggests heavy use or poor storage.
External wear is visible; internal state and valve seal cannot be verified.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its expiry date.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped date on the metal shroud or collar.

risks.risk: Valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: Video of a soap bubble test on the valve while under pressure.
Photo of the stamped capacity markings on the shroud.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the stamped markings on the handle/shroud showing the expiry date and capacity.
Close-up photo of the valve assembly.
response.reason: The capacity and expiry date are critical for pricing and safety but are not visible in the photo. The heavy paint wear makes it impossible to assume it is in 'good condition' without seeing the manufacturing stamps.
